goal: Formalize data-center rents funding safe personal wealth-building agents while testing the existing Tau theorem boundary; optimize concave household welfare with a universal floor and concentration limit; package proofs, Tau programs, tests, receipts, negative results, and a Research Kernel handoff in a draft PR.
decisions: Use equal civic weights plus concave harmonic utility as the default prioritarian objective.
Guarantee an explicit universal floor before allocating surplus.
Apply a per-household cap relative to the earmarked epoch budget and permit unspent reserve.
Treat personal Warren Buffett as shorthand for a constrained household wealth copilot, never a return claim.
Keep Tau external facts, source-to-binary provenance, environment attestation, settlement, and authority outside the theorem.
